svg.title: Inside /tk:review
svg.desc: Review reads what changed and sends it to the finders for each lens. Every finding carries a check anyone can run; a finding whose check fails goes to the audited-out log. Skeptics then try to refute the rest, one per seven findings, and three vote on any Block; refuted findings go to the log too. Survivors are fixed, and a verifier that is never the fixer checks each fix. A failed fix gets one more try; after two tries the fix is undone and you are asked.
